mapper.sql: AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM edu_class visible_class JOIN capacity_course visible_course ON visible_course.id = h.course_id AND visible_course.deleted = 0 AND visible_course.status = 0 JOIN edu_class_course visible_binding ON visible_binding.class_id = h.class_id AND visible_binding.course_id = h.course_id AND visible_binding.deleted = 0 AND visible_binding.status = 0 WHERE visible_class.id = h.class_id AND visible_class.deleted = 0 AND visible_class.status = 0 AND (TRIM(COALESCE(h.semester_name, '')) = '' OR TRIM(COALESCE(visible_binding.semester_name, '')) = '' OR TRIM(visible_binding.semester_name) = TRIM(h.semester_name)))
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM capacity_course WHERE deleted = 0 AND is_public_course = 0 AND public_audit_status = 1

SELECT DISTINCT cc.id AS id, cc.course_name AS name FROM capacity_course cc WHERE cc.deleted = 0 AND cc.status = 0
AND (cc.teacher_Id = #{teacherId} OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM capacity_course_member team WHERE team.course_id = cc.id AND team.user_id = #{teacherId} AND team.deleted = 0))
ORDER BY cc.course_name

SELECT hr.student_id AS studentId, su.nickname AS studentName, hr.score FROM edu_homework_record hr JOIN edu_homework h ON h.id = hr.homework_id AND h.deleted = 0 AND h.status IN (1, 2) JOIN system_users su ON hr.student_id = su.id AND su.deleted = 0 WHERE hr.deleted = 0 AND hr.status = 2 AND hr.homework_id = #{homeworkId} ORDER BY hr.score DESC LIMIT 5

SELECT hr.student_id AS studentId, su.nickname AS studentName, hr.score FROM edu_homework_record hr JOIN edu_homework h ON h.id = hr.homework_id AND h.deleted = 0 AND h.status IN (1, 2) JOIN system_users su ON hr.student_id = su.id AND su.deleted = 0 WHERE hr.deleted = 0 AND hr.status = 2 AND hr.homework_id = #{homeworkId} ORDER BY hr.score ASC LIMIT 5
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM system_users WHERE user_type = 2 AND deleted = 0 AND status = 0
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM system_users WHERE user_type = 1 AND deleted = 0 AND status = 0
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM capacity_course WHERE deleted = 0 AND status = 0
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM edu_homework h WHERE h.deleted = 0 AND h.status IN (1, 2)

SELECT COUNT(*) FROM edu_homework_record hr JOIN edu_homework h ON h.id = hr.homework_id AND h.deleted = 0 AND h.status IN (1, 2) WHERE hr.deleted = 0 AND hr.status IN (1, 2, 4) AND hr.create_time >= DATE_SUB(CURDATE(), INTERVAL WEEKDAY(CURDATE()) DAY)
AND hr.homework_id IN ( SELECT id FROM edu_homework WHERE teacher_id = #{teacherId} AND deleted = 0 )

SELECT COUNT(*) FROM edu_homework_record hr JOIN edu_homework h ON h.id = hr.homework_id AND h.deleted = 0 AND h.status IN (1, 2) WHERE hr.deleted = 0 AND hr.status IN (1, 4)
AND hr.homework_id IN (SELECT id FROM edu_homework WHERE teacher_id = #{teacherId} AND deleted = 0)

SELECT COUNT(*) FROM edu_homework_record hr JOIN edu_homework h ON h.id = hr.homework_id AND h.deleted = 0 AND h.status IN (1, 2) WHERE hr.deleted = 0 AND hr.status = 2 AND hr.score IS NOT NULL AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM edu_homework_ai_review ar WHERE ar.homework_record_id = hr.id AND ar.deleted = 0 AND ar.status IN (2, 4, 5))
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM capacity_course WHERE teacher_Id = #{teacherId} AND deleted = 0 AND status = 0

SELECT COUNT(*) FROM edu_message m WHERE m.type = 0 AND m.read_status = 0 AND m.deleted = 0 AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM edu_class_course cc JOIN capacity_course c ON c.id = cc.course_id AND c.deleted = 0 AND c.status = 0 JOIN edu_class ec ON ec.id = cc.class_id AND ec.deleted = 0 AND ec.status = 0 WHERE cc.class_id = m.class_id AND cc.course_id = m.course_id AND cc.deleted = 0 AND cc.status = 0 AND (c.teacher_Id = #{teacherId} OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM capacity_course_member team WHERE team.course_id = c.id AND team.user_id = #{teacherId} AND team.deleted = 0) OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM edu_class_course_assistant assistant WHERE assistant.class_course_id = cc.id AND assistant.teacher_id = #{teacherId} AND assistant.deleted = 0)) )

SELECT h.id AS homeworkId, h.homework_name AS homeworkName, h.status, h.create_time AS createTime, cc.course_name AS courseName FROM edu_homework h JOIN capacity_course cc ON h.course_id = cc.id AND cc.deleted = 0 AND cc.status = 0 WHERE h.deleted = 0 AND h.status IN (1, 2) AND h.teacher_id = #{teacherId} ORDER BY h.create_time DESC LIMIT 5
